observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' and 'D7500' visible on the top. The lens mount is covered by a cap with 'Nikon' and 'D7500' engraved. The camera has a red accent ring around the mode dial. The background shows a shelf with other cameras.

Photo 1: Back view of the camera showing the LCD screen, rear controls, and the 'Nikon' logo on the lower bezel. The screen is off. The camera has a strap attached. The background is blurred, showing a store environment.

Photo 2: Side view of the camera showing the top LCD screen, mode dial, and the 'Nikon' logo. The camera appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or dents. The strap is still attached.

claims.claim: This is a Clean UK Used Nikon D7500 DSLR Professional Camera Body Only
claims.evidence: The photos show the camera body with no visible damage, but there is no proof of origin (UK) or condition (clean) beyond the surface. The 'body only' claim is supported by the absence of lens and accessories, but not visually confirmed.
No video or photo shows the camera powered on, screen active, or any function in use. The screen is off in photo 1, and no operation is shown. This claim cannot be verified from the photos.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., LCD screen, shutter, or sensor issues)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powered on, screen displaying, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens or accessories may be missing despite 'body only' claim
risks.proof: Photo showing the camera with all included accessories (lens, battery, charger, strap, etc.) laid out.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, but with potential accessory loss

risks.risk: Camera may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos (e.g., sensor, mirror, shutter)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sensor and mirror, or a video of the camera in operation.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powered on and taking a photo.
Photo showing all included accessories (lens, battery, charger, strap, etc.).
Close-up photo of the sensor and mirror.
Photo of the camera's serial number or any internal labels for verification.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
